name: figma-forge
description: Build and modify Figma designs from Claude Code with first-class design-system awareness — library-first components, variant/property handling, token binding, and post-write QA. Talks to Figma through a bundled Figma plugin over a local WebSocket bridge, so no paid Figma seat is required.

bridge_port.title: Bridge port
bridge_port.description: Local WebSocket port the Figma plugin connects to. Change only if 3055 is taken.

channel.title: Default channel
channel.description: Channel name pairing this project with a Figma plugin session. Leave blank to derive it from the project directory name.
